---
title: theme-grey
subtitle: "Grey theme: light grey panel with white gridlines."
category: Themes
since: 0.1.0
engine: markdown
---


This is the gribouille default, equivalent to ggplot2's `theme_gray()`.

## Usage

```typst
theme-grey()
```



## Returns

Theme dictionary consumed by [`plot`](../core/plot.qmd).

## Examples

```{typst}
//| output-filename: "/assets/typst-render/theme-grey-1.svg"
//| width: 10cm
//| height: 6cm
#let d = range(0, 10).map(i => (x: i, y: i * 0.5))
#plot(
  data: d,
  mapping: aes(x: "x", y: "y"),
  layers: (geom-point(size: 2pt),),
  theme: theme-grey(),
)
```

[`theme-minimal`](theme-minimal.qmd), [`theme-classic`](theme-classic.qmd), [`theme-void`](theme-void.qmd), [`theme`](theme.qmd).
